summary: BioAtla filed an 8-K disclosing a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville), dated October 15, 2026, giving the Company the right but not the obligation to sell up to $40.0 million of common stock over 36 months. Advances are capped at 100% of five-day average daily volume, priced at 97% of the lowest daily VWAP over three trading days, with a $500,000 commitment fee (~2%). No special-situation transaction; this is a routine equity line financing, not a tender, activist or deal event.
